versions.changelog:
- Removed the file skill-card.md from the project.
- Clarified and expanded documentation about input parameters, templates, asset sizes, and generation modes in SKILL.md.
- Added explicit descriptions and enumerations for the mode parameter (basic, standard, advanced, demo).
- Improved organization and clarity of template and asset size selection documentation for easier user guidance.

toy-generator 1.0.0

- Initial release enabling AI-powered toy model generation via SOTA 3D APIs (Tripo/Meshy/etc) through OneKey Agent Gateway.
- Supports generating toy design drafts, creating 3D generation tasks, and polling results.
- Includes templates for figurines, stuffed toys, 3D printing, game assets, and architecture toys.
- Offers size options and multi-view design sheet generation for various toy types.
- Detailed API documentation and usage workflow provided in SKILL.md.
